benchmark.memory_contract: PSS is an identity-verified sampled/endpoint highwater, not an exact peak; allocated/reserved are process CUDA allocator counters, not board memory
benchmark.storage_contract: existing prepared data; operating-system storage caches were not dropped; no cold-storage claim
benchmark.timing_contract: driver wall differs from sum of job wall; stage and asynchronous IO timers are nested/overlapping and must not be summed; enqueue is not durable final CSV time

validation.zero_probability_policy: equal zero P and matching NaN/infinity are classified separately; finite log10 tolerance is not asserted for censored zero P
